blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACT Teachers party-list Antonio Tinio on Thursday believes that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. must be held accountable for implementing the 2024, 2025 and 2026 national budgets. His remark comes following the declaration of the Supreme Court (SC) that there are certain provisions that are unconstitutional. In its decision, SC said Congress committed grave abuse of discretion by increasing national budgets beyond the president’s recommended appropriations. The high tribunal declared unconstitutional Congress’s increase of unprogrammed appropriations (UA) by P449.5 billion in the 2024 General Appropriations Act (GAA), the increase of the Special Road Fund by P17.992 billion in the […]...
